targets.expr:
rate(inbound_rtp_packetsLost{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="audio"}[$__rate_interval]) 
/ 
(
    rate(inbound_rtp_packetsLost{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="audio"}[$__rate_interval]) + 
    rate(inbound_rtp_packetsReceived{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="audio"}[$__rate_interval])
)

delta(inbound_rtp_jitterBufferDelay{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="audio"}[$__interval]) / (delta(inbound_rtp_jitterBufferEmittedCount{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="audio"}[$__interval]))

rate(inbound_rtp_packetsLost{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="video", trackIdentifier!="probator"}[$__rate_interval]) 
/ 
(
  rate(inbound_rtp_packetsLost{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="video", trackIdentifier!="probator"}[$__rate_interval]) 
  + rate(inbound_rtp_packetsReceived{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="video", trackIdentifier!="probator"}[$__rate_interval])
)

inbound_rtp_jitterBufferDelay{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="video", trackIdentifier!="probator"} / inbound_rtp_jitterBufferEmittedCount{pageUrl="$pageUrl", peerConnectionId=~"$peerConnectionId", exported_job="$job", kind="video", trackIdentifier!="probator"}
